origin: Found in the generator itself, not in play. Iterated-map items in the FALSE_WITH_WITNESS class were marking a generalization step 'justified' while the sweep stopped short of the witness, so a claim that was FALSE passed every step check and came out with a fully VALID argument. The pilot's coupling detector caught it.
why_it_is_a_canary: This is the cleanest available synthetic regression test for the whole 'range establishment / generalization' defense family. If the arena later promotes a defense that claims to catch bounded-search-sold-as-proof and that defense misses this case, the claim is falsified — no play data required, no agent needed, no interpretation.
attack_family: generalization beyond the established range (bounded search presented as proof)
detection_criterion: the conclusion step s3 must be flagged; the argument as a whole must not be reported as VALID

positive_example.description: sweep reaches n = 500; conclusion asserts n = 3000 and marks itself justified

steps.text: Every n in [1, 50] reaches 1 in fewer than 220 steps; checked directly.
A direct sweep verifies every n in [1, 500] has stopping time below 220.
The sweep covers [1, 500]; the statement holds for every n in [1, 3000].

negative_example.description: identical shape, but the sweep reaches the full asserted range n = 3000

steps.text: Every n in [1, 50] reaches 1 in fewer than 220 steps; checked directly.
A direct sweep verifies every n in [1, 3000] has stopping time below 220.
The sweep covers [1, 3000], which is the whole asserted range.

negative_example.note: A defense that flags this case is rejecting valid exhaustive verification. Per the rulebook, no defense is promoted without a negative example it correctly accepts; this is that example.

second_finding: Freezing this case immediately exposed a second, deeper hole: the original fix was applied at the generator (producer) side, so a hand-authored derivation could still assert justified=True by fiat and the argument oracle would accept it. derivation.py now requires `justified` to name a step in the same derivation whose check establishes a step relation (forall_identity or congruence). A bounded sweep is not such a step, however far it reached. The canary found this before any player did.
